description: Alkira is a network infrastructure as-a-service company that unifies multiple clouds, sites, and users via an enterprise network.

AmplifAI uses AI-driven technology to improve employee performance by providing personalized coaching, real-time insights, and data-driven performance management solutions to help teams reach their full potential.
Aragorn is the single platform that helps teams within small and large businesses streamline and automate vendor and IT integrations

Arnica is an application security posture management (ASPM) company that helps businesses identify and mitigate risks in their code. Arnica offers a variety of solutions, including code security, secret detection, and developer access management.
Ballerine is a KYB SaaS product, helping financial institutions manage merchant risk and compliance through automated, AI driven fraud detection.
Bluecopa offers a cloud-based platform designed to automate finance operations for fast-growing businesses.
BluSapphire is a cloud native, cyber resilience AI platform which helps identify and mitigate cyber breach, providing 24/7 managed detection, response, and guided remediation.

Citylitics is a company that sells information on future infrastructure projects. They target companies that sell to municipalities and utilities. Citylitics gathers information from public documents to predict what projects will be built and claims this can help companies win more bids.

CoreStack offers a cloud governance platform that helps enterprises manage and optimize their multi-cloud environments through AI-powered automation, compliance, cost management, and operational governance.
CrewAI provides an enterprise platform for building, deploying, and managing AI agents, enabling teams to automate complex workflows through coordinated, multi-agent systems.
Dice is a spend management solution that disrupts the way enterprises consume B2B goods and services and manages corporate spending.
Disprz is an AI-powered skill & career acceleration platform

Docyt is an accounting automation software that uses AI to automate accounting tasks. This can help businesses save time and money. Docyt AI integrates with QuickBooks and some of its features include expense management, revenue reconciliation, and month-end close.

DQLabs operates in the Data Management and Data Quality sector, offering an AI-based platform that automates data quality checks and remediation to ensure reliable and accurate data for better business outcomes.

Fiddler AI, helps enterprises ensure their AI models are working as expected. They achieve this by providing a comprehensive AI Observability platform, explaining model decisions through Explainable AI (XAI) capabilities, and identifying any potential biases. By doing so, they bring more clarity and trust in AI.
Hippo Video provides a video CX platform to help businesses engage with their audiences in an authentic way through personalized videos.

Holistica AI is an AI governance platform that helps businesses manage AI risks and ensure that their AI systems are fair, unbiased, and secure. It helps businesses comply with relevant AI regulations.
IntelleWings develops AI and DeepTech powered AML/CFT solutions

Kore.ai is a leading conversational AI platform that empowers businesses to automate and enhance customer experiences through intelligent virtual assistants and chatbots. Their solutions streamline customer interactions, boost productivity, and drive digital transformation across industries, delivering personalized, human-like conversations with minimal effort and seamless integration.

Mojro uses AI-powered logistics planning and optimization technology to help enterprises make smarter transportation decisions across routes, schedules, vehicles, loads, and other complex operational constraints.
Nirmata provides SaaS for unified governance, security, and compliance for cloud-native applications and infrastructure
Offers a generative AI software solution for synthetic data management. It provides a platform to manage data sparsity and data sharing restrictions for data scientists.

Plnar leverages AI to create fully digitized property assessments by converting images into precise measurements and 3D models, streamlining the claims and renovation processes for insurance and home improvement industries.
Prophecy is a low-code data transformation platform that allows data engineers and analysts to build data pipelines visually, without needing to write code.
Pynt uses AI-powered technology to automate API security testing, helping organizations discover vulnerabilities, test APIs, and secure applications throughout the development lifecycle.

Rollick helps businesses in the RV, Marine, Powersports, and Equipment industries find, win, and keep customers. They achieve this by connecting these businesses with potential customers and also offer a marketplace for buying recreational vehicles called GoRollick.com

Secufusion is a Dallas-based cybersecurity innovator pioneering Unified AI Detection & Response (AIDR), a new security architecture designed for the AI-driven enterprise. By bringing Browser Detection & Response (BDR) and AIDR together in one platform, Secufusion secures the point where users, data, and AI interactions converge.
Simplismart is the fastest inference engine for GenAI Workloads

StepFunction is a company that uses AI to improve customer success for businesses. It helps businesses predict which customers are at risk of churning and recommend actions to improve customer health and satisfaction.

Viviota provides high-performance data analytics solutions for engineering and scientific applications, helping companies accelerate the analysis and visualization of time-series data to improve decision-making and innovation.
VuNet is a AI powered Business Journey Observability platform
